name: month_number
description: Convert an integer month number to its English month name; matched control writes the number as a cardinal word.
generator_code:
import random,json,calendar
random.seed(0)
nums='one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve'.split();items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=i%12+1;ctx=random.choice(['In the calendar','In a year','Using the standard calendar','For a date'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{ctx}, month number {n} is called', 'answer':' '+calendar.month_name[n]})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{ctx}, month number {n} is written as the cardinal word', 'answer':' '+nums[n-1]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
